# What changed?

Describe the research, protocol, documentation, or evidence change.

## Evidence

What receipts, logs, references, or reproducible observations support it?

## Classification

- [ ] FACT
- [ ] EXECUTED_RESULT
- [ ] INFERENCE
- [ ] UNKNOWN
- [ ] BLOCKED

## Integrity check

- [ ] Observation is separated from interpretation
- [ ] No secrets or private data are included
- [ ] Authority and capability are not conflated
- [ ] Results are not claimed beyond the available evidence
